skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of business strategies in e-commerce.
Apply various tools to analyze business environment and identify strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.
Identify core competencies and competitive advantages of businesses in e-commerce.
Understand how to use SWOT matrix in strategic planning and select appropriate strategies for different stages.
Find reliable sources of information on infrastructure, telecommunication, electronic payments, security, human resources, e-government, digital economy, etc.
Practice working in groups and making group decisions.
Develop and apply skills in collecting and using reliable information sources for analysis and enhancing teamwork skills.
